# thousandeyes_tag (Data Source)

Looks up a single ThousandEyes tag by its identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thousandeyes_tag" "example" {
  id = "<id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The identifier of the tag to look up.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `access_type` (String) The tag's access level. Documented values are `all`, `partner` and `system`. <!-- probed:7.0.97-t1785295713598 --> Values accepted here: `all`. The specification documents `system`, which the API rejected. The API enforces this field's presence, which the specification does not declare. <!-- /probed -->
- `account_group_id` (Number) The account group the tag belongs to. Computed rather than configurable: the provider scopes every request through its own `account_group_id` setting, so accepting a second value here would let the two disagree.
- `assignments` (Attributes Set) Objects this tag is assigned to. The API returns assignments only when the request asks for them to be expanded, which this data source does not, so this is null rather than empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assignments))
- `built_in` (Boolean) Whether the tag is built in rather than user-created.
- `color` (String) The tag's display colour as a hex string. Computed as well as optional because the API assigns one when it is omitted; this has not yet been confirmed by probing. <!-- probed:7.0.97-t1785295713598 --> Observed: the API assigns "#A7EB10" when this is omitted. <!-- /probed -->
- `create_date` (String) When the tag was created.
- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the tag.
- `filters` (Attributes Set) Filters that dynamically assign this tag to endpoint agents. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `icon` (String) The tag's icon. <!-- probed:7.0.97-t1785295713598 --> Observed: the API assigns "LABEL" when this is omitted. <!-- /probed -->
- `key` (String) The tag's key. Together with `value` this forms the label applied to assigned objects.
- `legacy_id` (Number) The tag's identifier in the v6 API. Typed as a number because the specification declares it as one, although observed values are integral; probing will settle whether this should be an integer.
- `match_type` (String) How the tag's filters combine when it is assigned dynamically. <!-- probed:7.0.97-t1785295713598 --> Values accepted here: `and`, `or`. <!-- /probed -->
- `modified_date` (String) When the tag was last modified.
- `object_type` (String) The kind of object the tag may be assigned to. Documented values are `test`, `v-agent`, `endpoint-test`, `dashboard` and `connected-devices-test`. The generated validator permits the whole documented set, which is wider than what any one tenant accepts, so a stale specification surfaces as the API's own error rather than as a plan failure. <!-- probed:7.0.97-t1785295713598 --> Values accepted here: `test`, `dashboard`, `endpoint-test`, `v-agent`, `connected-devices-test`. The specification documents `endpoint-agent`, which the API rejected. The API enforces this field's presence, which the specification does not declare. <!-- /probed -->
- `type` (String) The tag's type, assigned by the API.
- `value` (String) The tag's value. <!-- probed:7.0.97-t1785295713598 --> The API enforces this field's presence, which the specification does not declare. <!-- /probed -->

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assignments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The identifier of the object the tag is assigned to.
- `type` (String) The kind of object assigned. Documented values are `test`, `v-agent`, `endpoint-test`, `dashboard` and `connected-devices-test`.


<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The filter key used for matching.
- `mode` (String) How the filter values are matched.
- `scope` (String) The scope the filter applies within.
- `values` (Set of String) The values the filter matches against.
